question: True or false: React turns off ViewTransition animations for users who prefer reduced motion.
say: True or false: React turns off View Transition animations for users who prefer reduced motion.
explanation: False. React doesn't do it for you. The docs recommend always adding a prefers-reduced-motion media query to your view transition CSS.
explainSay: False. React leaves that to you. Add a prefers reduced motion media query to your CSS.
